changes.historical_text: During a Battle Phase, you can use this effect on 1 monster that has attacked this turn and is equipped with a Union Monster. Change the Union Monster back to a monster in face-up Attack or Defense Position. Also, the monster that was equipped with the Union Monster may attack again this turn.
changes.modern_text: During a Battle Phase, you can use this effect on 1 monster that has attacked this turn and is equipped with a Union Monster. Change the Union Monster back to a monster in face-up Attack or Defense Position. Also, the monster that was equipped with the Union Monster may attack again this turn.
changes.summary: Era eligibility semantics encoded per card with no text change: the goat script requires the chosen monster to have actually battled this turn (`c:GetBattledGroupCount()>0`, upstream-annotated "If a replay occurred, the monster can be targeted") where the modern script requires only that it announced an attack (`c:GetAttackAnnouncedCount()==0` rejects), and the goat equip filter additionally accepts a Union equipped by Union Rider (`c:GetFlagEffect(11743119)~=0`) beside EFFECT_UNION_STATUS, which the modern filter does not. The modern script also refuses the multi-Union case while its controller is affected by CARD_BLUEEYES_SPIRIT and checks free zones per controller, where the era script only needs a free zone for the equip card's owner. Chronology of these readings is unresolved.

review.notes: Text-identical (goat 504700012 cdb text == pinned modern cards.cdb text) and the errata page (revid 5739966) lists only a Japanese lineage, so literal texts are carried on the change and no printing is available to date anything. Union Rider is passcode 11743119, confirmed from the header of official/c11743119.lua in the pinned CardScripts checkout. EdisonFormat's Union entry ('Machina Gearframe (and all Union Monsters)') concerns the Union monsters' own 1-Union-per-monster Condition, not this card, so it corroborates nothing here and is not cited as a source. The phase test differs in form only (`Duel.IsBattlePhase()` vs the PHASE_BATTLE_START..PHASE_BATTLE range).
